faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SPMCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SPMCIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Executives of Central Public Sector Enterprises posts in the SPMCIL Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are distributed among Deputy CVO, Manager (Vigilance), and Supervisor (Vigilance) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Supervisor (Vigilance) post?
faq.answer: For the Supervisor (Vigilance) post, candidates need to have a 1st class Full-time Diploma in any stream of Engineering. Higher qualifications like B.Tech, B.E., or B.Sc. (Engg.) are also considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Deputy CVO post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Deputy CVO post is 50 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion as of the crucial date mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for SPMCIL Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Manager (Vigilance) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Manager (Vigilance) post is in the pay scale of Rs. 60,000-1,80,000 per month. This is a competitive salary package for the selected candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Does SPMCIL offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details for reserved categories in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such provisions.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational/experience certificates along with the application form.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes scrutiny of applications, assessment of eligibility and experience, and a personal interview or interaction. The Competent Authority may decide on other methods as well.

faq.answer: The official notification and application form can typically be found on the official website of SPMCIL. Links to these documents are usually provided in the 'Important Links' section of job notification articles.
